sources.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio GitHub harness GA (skills, MCP, memory)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Microsoft announced general availability of the GitHub Copilot harness in Copilot Studio on 2026-09-02 (framed as August 2026 updates), positioned as the foundation for reasoning-heavy agents and workflows; the harness sits between model and agent/workflow to orchestrate model calls, context, tools, MCP servers, and connected agents with recursive adaptive planning.
claims.context: Primary official Microsoft Copilot Blog retrieved 2026-09-17.

claims.text: The harness supports skills and memory, natively creates and edits Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files, runs each task in a secure Copilot Studio sandbox, coexists alongside the standard harness, and is illustrated by an accounts-payable agent reading invoices, matching purchase orders, gathering missing information, and routing exceptions.
claims.context: Capability, sandbox, harness-choice, and example statements from the official announcement.

claims.text: The same update makes workflows and MCP servers available as tools (GA) and Windows 365 for Agents MCP server (GA), with connected agents, Work IQ organizational context, memory, direct file analysis, and environment-level agent telemetry in preview; Entra Agent ID auto-provisioning applies to new agents since July 2026; Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.5 Chat are GA as primary models; real-time agents extend from voice to digital messaging in preview.
claims.context: Release-state enumeration (GA versus preview) from the official announcement; preview items remain subject to change.

claims.text: Microsoft positions the harness as enabling agents that reason through complex work, draw on richer context, and adapt execution paths to goals and inputs rather than relying on predefined paths.
claims.context: Vendor effectiveness framing for reasoning-heavy multi-step scenarios; no controlled performance comparison provided in this source.

limitations.text: Vendor blog only; no independent verification of reasoning quality, tool-use reliability, or sandbox guarantees.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Many adjacent capabilities are in preview with behavior and availability subject to change.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Model availability (e.g., Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.5 Chat) is stated without pricing, region, or limit details.
